title: artpipe naming conventions
description: Validates an asset manifest (the names inside one exported asset). Each $defs entry is also used directly by the validator's naming check. Grammar: <Type>_<AssetName>[_<Variant>][_LOD<n>]. AssetName is PascalCase with no underscores, so names always split unambiguously on '_'.
$comment: Patterns use the subset shared by ECMA-262 (JSON Schema validators) and Python re: no lookbehind, no named groups, no inline flags. Python code must use re.fullmatch(), because '$' in Python also matches before a trailing newline. Examples under 'examples' must match; 'x-invalid-examples' must not. tests/test_conventions.py enforces both.

mesh_file.description: Exported model file. SM_ = static mesh, SK_ = skinned mesh. Optional variant: one capital letter or two digits.

group_node.description: Optional single root group in the Maya scene. Must equal the file name without extension.

mesh_node.description: Mesh transform. _LOD<n> (0-3) is required when the asset has more than one LOD and omitted otherwise. Unity's model importer builds a LODGroup automatically from _LOD0.._LODn suffixes.

material.description: Material name. Shared atlas materials across many assets are encouraged on mobile (fewer draw calls, better batching).

texture_file.description: Texture file. Suffix = map type, defined in texture_rules.yaml (D base color, N normal, MS metallic/smoothness, AO occlusion, E emission).
